alternates.summary: The Trump administration official who runs US export control programs was looking for marquee names for his agency’s upcoming annual conference and threw an unusual option into the mix: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang.
alternates.title: Nvidia Crisis Spurs Scrutiny of Agency That Oversees Chip Curbs

alternates.summary: Nina Trentmann, senior editor at Bloomberg News, says Colette Kress is likely to become more visible as Nvidia’s interim CEO, speaking more about the company’s finances, performance and plans after Jensen Huang’s departure. She speaks with Vonnie Quinn on “The Close”. (Source: Bloomberg)
alternates.title: Colette Kress Will Face Scrutiny at Nvidia

ChatGPT Wallet is rolling out starting today for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US aged 18 and older using a US billing address and "eligible US-issued American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa cards." After adding a card […]
articles.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you

articles.summary: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.
articles.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say

articles.summary: New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.
articles.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!

articles.summary: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.
articles.title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you

articles.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation

articles.summary: Normally, the products I test don't offer to help me write up my experience with them. Duet is different. Claude Duet is Anthropic's AI agent for consumers, the latest attempt by an AI company to try to convince us that agents can be useful for people who don't write code. It's been an interesting couple […]
articles.title: Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful

articles.summary: Match Group is embracing artificial intelligence across its business, but CEO Spencer Rascoff says AI agents won't be allowed to date for users on Tinder, Hinge and its other apps. Rascoff says Match wants its platforms to remain a “human-only zone,” even as the company uses AI to verify identities, improve safety and block harmful messages. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss where companies should draw the line on AI and how the technology is transforming Match Group. He also weighs ibn on Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia and why he thinks companies are ultimately bigger than any one CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title: Match Group Keeping AI Out of Dating

articles.summary: Bill Ackman, Pershing Square founder and CEO, says it's sad to see Jensen Huang leave Nvidia and he'll go on to do something great. Ackman also says he was impressed with the presentation given by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei at the company's IPO roadshow event in New York. He speaks to Bloomberg's Isabelle Lee. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title: Ackman on Huang's Exit, Anthropic IPO Roadshow
